content.heading: Mortgage, mortgagor, mortgagee, mortgage-money and mortgage-deed defined
content.text: A mortgage is the transfer of an interest in specific immovable property for the purpose of securing the payment of money advanced or to be advanced by way of loan, an existing or future debt, or the performance of an engagement which may give rise to a pecuniary liability. The section then defines simple mortgage, mortgage by conditional sale, usufructuary mortgage, English mortgage, mortgage by deposit of title-deeds and anomalous mortgage. Read the official clauses.
